newsitem.title: USA: Trans-World welcomes Kulikov's view on property.
newsitem.headline: Trans-World welcomes Kulikov's view on property.

text.p: Trans-World Group, the trading powerhouse at the center of a highly public spat over aluminum with the Russian government, said it welcomed Interior Minister Anatoly Kulikov's reassurances Monday that private property in Russia was safe from takeover.

"I am really pleased that he is looking at it from a different perspective and we will help Mr Kulikov in every way possible to ensure Russia's long-term growth," Trans-World's executive chairman David Reuben said in a telephone interview.

"But nobody can be reassured by one statement - we will see as days go by. It's not only us that needs reassuring. Prosperity is dependent on new investments in Russia," Reuben added, speaking from Washington.

On Monday, Reuben and his attorneys met in Washington D.C. with several representatives of the U.S. Commerce and State Departments to explain the company's role in Russia, concerns over confiscation of assets, and imposition of import duties on raw materials into Russia.

Reuben said he had not yet seen the letter Kulikov sent to the company in response to a high profile media campaign launched by Trans-World last week to clear its name of what it sees as false allegations regarding the trade house's involvement in the Russian aluminum sector.
In his letter, made available to Reuters earlier Tuesday, Kulikov restated that fair competition between foreign and domestic companies in the Russian aluminum sector still did not exist.
But state takeover of private assets in the aluminum sector, such as Trans-World's shares in the Bratsk and Sayansk smelters, was not in the cards, the minister said.
"Today, no one would even put it into his head to doubt the steadfastness of the institution of private property," Kulikov wrote.

On February 21 in the Duma parliament, Kulikov said Russia's aluminum sector needed protecting from foreign companies, and suggested duties should be slapped on imports of raw materials for aluminum production.
Trans-World is a leading importer into Russia of alumina for metal production and plays a key role in ensuring Bratsk and Sayansk smelters continue to make metal.
